text:
mia: Heads up: I found several examples in docs/api-ref/endpoints/chat_generate.md and docs/snippets/python/chat_gen_example.md using Content-Type: text/plain in curl/python examples. This is causing confusion and some SDK test failures. I'm prepping a tiny PR to change to application/json and add an explicit example response envelope.
sam: Can you paste the exact curl/python blocks so I can grep the snippets generator?
mia: Current curl in chat_generate.md:
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate\" -H \"Content-Type: text/plain\" -d '{\"input\": \"hello\"}'
```
mia: Proposed change:
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"input\": \"hello\"}'
```
alejandro: Also include a short non-streaming response example so users know the shape. Something like:
```json
{ \"id\": \"r_abc123\", \"result\": { \"output\": \"Hi there!\", \"tokens\": 14 } }
```
kate: Please add a note under \"Response content-type\" clarifying: non-streaming endpoints return application/json; SSE endpoints use text/event-stream and should keep that header. Folks often try to set application/json for SSE and it breaks.
mia: Good call. I'll add a one-line migration hint for SDKs: change header and update client.parse_json() calls if tests expect plain text.
sam: Are there any generated examples besides those two files? Might be snippets used in other language docs.
mia: I searched the repo: docs/snippets/*chat* and docs/api-ref/*chat*. Only the two had text/plain. I also updated docs/snippets/python/chat_gen_example.md to show parsing the JSON envelope:
```python
resp = client.post('/v1/chat/generate', json={'input': 'hello'})
body = resp.json()
print(body.get('result', {}).get('output'))
```
alejandro: Add a small error example to show error.code/error.message so integrators know what to check for.
mia: Added error payload example and a one-liner: `if 'error' in body: raise ApiError(body['error']['code'], body['error']['message'])`
docs-bot: PR created by @mia: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/8491 3 reviewers: @alejandro @sam @kate
kate: Quick API review done, wording tweak about error fields accepted.
sam: LGTM from docs side. Approving in GH.
mia: Merged. Will follow up with a small change log blurb in docs/CHANGELOG.md and ping eng-qa in case any tests expect old header. Thanks all :tada:
